The throwing guard is `assertCan` in `src/lib/permissions.ts:150`. It calls `explain()` and throws `PermissionDeniedError` when the decision is denied; `can()` is the boolean counterpart. Fourteen source files call `assertCan` at real call sites. Three other source files mention it only in comments (`src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts`, `src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx`, `src/components/domain/permission/permission-gate.tsx`), so I left them out. Test files, `scripts/`, and `corpus-manifest.json` also reference it, but they aren't source callers, so they're excluded too.
